Today's selection covers 93 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 71 on Artificial Intelligence and 21 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Says Its A.I. Models Hacked Into Hugging Face, a Digital Library

• **Security Alert**: Attackers Are Learning to Live Off the AI Toolchain
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 56 articles published in the last 24 hours
